name: Ignis
subtitle: The Boss

description: A fusion of organic flesh and cold machinery. Giger-inspired biomechanical design that blurs the line between creature and construct. Highly detailed textures throughout.

description: Classic dragon-scale aesthetic with sweeping ridges and a powerful presence. Designed for both visual impact and intense sensory feedback.

name: Pyra

description: Flowing flame-like forms captured in glossy silicone. A lighter, more fluid design that emphasizes movement and visual drama.
